name: Drag reducing agents
principle: Ultra-high-molecular-weight polymers injected at parts-per-million levels suppress turbulent bursts and cut frictional pressure drop by up to 70%. Field cases in an Offshore magazine article (2005, vendor-authored) show 6 to 51% more throughput.

process_steps.name: Polymer reduces turbulence along the line
Polymer degrades in pumps; re-inject downstream

source.note: Offshore magazine, Drag reducers improve throughput, cut costs (2005; vendor-authored)

performance.basis: 18,200 to 23,160 b/d with discharge pressure cut from 250-255 to 220-230 psig
